summary: Frontend-only Playwright testing of FretStudio (Expo web, 390x844 portrait + 844x390 landscape). All requested flows pass: tabs, 150 note testIDs (s0 top = high e, s5 bottom = low E), note tap info (s5-f3 => G2, 98.0 Hz), all fret markers (3,5,7,9,15,17,19,21,12-a/b,24-a/b), strict degree colors verified (root #EF4444, 3rd #3B82F6, 5th #10B981, 7th #F59E0B, 13th #06B6D4, neutral grey), mode/root/octave/formula chips update fretboard-title, layer toggles hide/show (65->52->65 notes), octave filter, label-mode degree/note, toggle-neutral. NEW scale picker works (12 scales grouped, 20 chords, root chips, item select closes sheet and updates title, close button + backdrop close). NEW landscape works: control panel hidden, fret-number-16 fully visible (right edge 821px < 844), compact header with picker/play buttons, rotating back restores panel and state. Ear: 3 quiz modes, reveal/skip, counters, mic toggle starts/stops with no crash, denied-permission path shows mic-blocked-card + retry. Settings: 3 switches, notation latin (C->Do, Réb), flats (Solb), A4 +/- (441 Hz reflected in Hz on fretboard), reset-best feedback, settings persist after reload. Found and fixed one layout bug (ChipRow collapsing to ~10px height in landscape). Remaining: wrong string-number label, mic not stopped when leaving Ear tab, deprecated expo-router/unstable-native-tabs import, portrait title truncation.

ui_bugs.issue: String numbering inverted: tapping low E string (note-s5-f3) shows 'Corde 1', high e (note-s0-f0) shows 'Corde 6'. The standard convention (FR/EN) is corde 1 = high e, corde 6 = low E. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx:123 uses `6 - active.string`; it should be `active.string + 1`.

ui_bugs.component: ChipRow in landscape (FIXED by testing agent)
ui_bugs.issue: Horizontal ScrollView ChipRow collapsed to ~10px height in landscape (picker-root-selector in ScalePicker, quiz-mode-selector on Ear), so chips looked squashed and overlapping. Root cause: RN-web ScrollView defaults to flexShrink:1. Fixed by adding flexShrink:0 to styles.row in /app/frontend/src/components/Chip.tsx:57. Now 52px, verified in both orientations, landscape fretboard still fits.

integration_issues.issue: The mic keeps listening after leaving the Ear tab (tabs stay mounted and nothing stops it on blur/useFocusEffect). Coming back still shows 'Arrêter l’écoute'. This is a privacy and battery issue, and the detector keeps running while the user plays notes on the Manche tab. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/ear.tsx:183 (usePitchDetector(listening,...)).

issues: fretboard-title gets cut off with long names (e.g. 'A Pentatoniq…', 'Mineure mélodique') because the Gamme and Écouter buttons take the width. Consider moving the formula name to a second line or shrinking the buttons.
Note touch targets are 34px tall (portrait) and about 41x34 (landscape), under the 44pt guideline. This is probably acceptable for a dense fretboard, but hitSlop is only 2.
Tapping picker-mode-chord/scale switches the fretboard mode right away (title becomes 'Gmaj7') before any item is chosen. If the user then closes the sheet, the mode has still changed.

Prompt wording uses extension names for simple degrees, e.g. 'Joue la treizième (6) de D6' and 'Joue la onzième (4) de Asus4'. Musically it should be 'sixte'/'quarte' for 6/4 (and 'la onzième' should be 'l’onzième').

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecated import, runtime warning: '`expo-router/unstable-native-tabs` is deprecated. Use `expo-router/native-tabs` instead.' Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx:2

action_items: Fix the string number in the note info bar: use `Corde {active.string + 1}` (index.tsx:123).
Stop the mic when the Ear tab loses focus (useFocusEffect from expo-router -> setListening(false) on blur).
Migrate `import { NativeTabs } from 'expo-router/unstable-native-tabs'` to 'expo-router/native-tabs' in app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx.
Optional: stop the portrait fretboard-title from being cut off; delay the picker mode change until an item is selected; fix the degree quiz wording (sixte/quarte/seconde).
critical_code_review_comments: ear.tsx is 493 lines; consider splitting the tuner dial and quiz card into components.
onFrame calls setDetected every 70ms, which re-renders the whole Ear screen about 14 times per second; consider throttling or isolating the dial component.
Score/streak/best increments rely on real mic input and could not be verified headless; reset-best was only checked with best=0.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all requested flows functional; 1 label bug, 1 mic lifecycle issue)

seed_data_creation: None. Settings changed during the test were restored to defaults (English, sharps, A4 440, sound on, strict octave off, neutral on).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend-only app, settings stored locally (persist across reload). Fretboard testIDs: note-s{0-5}-f{0-24}, fret-number-{n}. Landscape check: viewport 844x390, fret-number-16 should end before x=844. Mic in headless Chromium uses a fake device; override getUserMedia via add_init_script to test the denied path.
rca_of_issue: ChipRow collapse: RN-web ScrollView has flexShrink:1, so with a constrained height (landscape Modal or Ear screen) the 52px row shrank to fit. Fixed with flexShrink:0.
